decisions.reason: The candle arch is close to the core offer and was featured on the home page in both years, which suggests satisfactory results in a growing industry that gives no reason for problemistic search.
The Christmas pyramid is a core traditional item with steady prominence and low incremental cost, so it likely meets aspirations and fits established workshop capacity.
The electronic music box is distant from the core and its results are less certain, but its continued home-page presence and rising industry demand provide slack to keep carrying it.
The release of a second edition signals results above aspiration, so management has reason to continue the motif platform line.

The Christmas motif platform was only mentioned rather than featured, which gives weaker evidence of success, but it is a seasonal add-on to an existing system and cheap to retain while demand is good.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on core craftsmanship and was consistently featured, indicating satisfactory performance worth keeping.
